label: Introduction
subgoals: Separate identities (all angles) from equations (some angles)
Group by transformation: shift, sum, product, parametric
Reduce every expression toward sine and cosine

label: Fundamental identities
subgoals: Start from sin^2 + cos^2 = 1 on the unit circle
Divide by cos^2 for 1 + tan^2 = sec^2
Divide by sin^2 for 1 + cot^2 = csc^2

label: Reference angles and reflections
subgoals: Rewrite pi/2 + alpha via swapped cofunctions
Keep functions fixed for pi +/- alpha shifts
Assign signs from the target quadrant
